## Constraints

### Must

- One accent only: deep petrol teal (light #0E7C7F, dark #2FB0AA). Everything else neutral.
- Flat surfaces: hairlines (--border / --border-strong) for definition; shadows only via --shadow-pop on modals and tooltips.
- Fira Sans everywhere; times use tabular-nums.
- Text contrast >= 4.5:1 for all text tokens on every surface, in both themes.
- Radii: 6px controls, 8px inputs/buttons, 12px panels/modals; bubbles 12px with one 4px tail corner.
- Icons from lucide-react only (no emoji as UI icons); green reserved for the presence dot.

### Avoid

- Gradients of any kind (background-image: linear/radial-gradient).
- Glassmorphism: backdrop-filter / backdrop-blur.
- Glow effects, colourful blur blobs, dot textures.
- Neumorphism (inset/raised shadow pairs) and heavy drop shadows.
- Pill-shaped buttons or segmented pill controls (tabs are underline-style; theme picker is a checkmark list).
- Stacked rounded cards; prefer grouped panels with hairline dividers.
- Purple/violet, coral, neon or multi-accent palettes.

## Decisions

- **quiet-ink-redesign**: Replaced the violet/coral neumorphic system with 'Quiet Ink': neutral paper/charcoal surfaces, hairlines instead of shadows, strong type hierarchy, and one petrol-teal accent. The old look read as generic AI-generated design (gradients, glows, glass, blur blobs). (src/index.css)
- **single-petrol-accent**: One accent colour only - deep petrol teal (#0E7C7F light / #2FB0AA dark). The coral --accent token was removed and all bg-accent/text-accent usages now use primary. Distinctive without copying WhatsApp green or Telegram blue. (src/index.css)
- **flat-surfaces-hairlines**: Controls and panels are flat: solid fills or hairline borders; --shadow-pop is reserved for modals and tooltips. Bubbles are solid teal (outgoing) and white/dark with a hairline (incoming), 12px radius with a 4px tail corner. (src/index.css)
- **dense-messaging-lists**: Chat and contact lists use dense 2-line rows with hairline separators, an accent tint for the active chat, tabular timestamps and a CountBadge for unread - reads like a daily messaging product, not marketing UI. (src/components/chat/ChatListItem.tsx)
- **profile-grouped-settings**: Profile dropped the gradient hero and 3-up stats row in favour of one grouped settings panel (identity, account, appearance, about, danger). Appearance is a checkmark list, not a segmented pill control. (src/pages/app/ProfilePage.tsx)
- **ink-auth-panel**: The auth screen uses a solid ink brand column (--panel) with no gradient or blur, and the auth inputs have no leading icons - restrained and editorial, and the first field keeps autofocus for keyboard users. (src/pages/auth/AuthLayout.tsx)
- **programmatic-ui-audit**: UI verification includes a headless-Chrome CDP audit over 14 routes x 2 themes asserting zero gradients/backdrop-filter, no horizontal overflow or offscreen elements, correct accent per theme, and text contrast >= 4.5:1. Used because screenshots cannot be inspected by the agent. (docs/DOCUMENTATION.md)
